fixCommits.msg: fix(cinematic): rewrite player for bulletproof mobile touch
fixCommits.body:
ROOT CAUSE: Skip button was unresponsive on mobile because:
1. #nwg-cinematic (position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999) had pointer-events:auto
   set via JS, making it capture ALL touch events across the entire viewport
2. Mobile browsers dispatch touchstart to the first element in hit-test order
   that accepts pointer-events — the wrapper grabbed touches before buttons
3. The wrapper's tapToPlayTouch handler called e.preventDefault(), eating events
4. Even with buttons at z-index:100001, they shared a stacking context issue

FIX — Three-layer architecture:
- Layer 1: #nwg-cinematic (z:99999) — visual only, pointer-events:none on
  itself AND all children. Never captures any touch/click events.
- Layer 2: #nwg-cine-touch (z:100000) — invisible tap overlay for
  play/unmute. Self-removes (display:none) after first tap so it can never
  block button presses afterwards.
- Layer 3: Skip/Pause buttons (z:200001) — completely outside all wrapper
  divs, independent stacking context, guarantee
